openai.reasoning: Respondent consistently argues that red is the individually dominant/safe choice (and blue can lead to death if others choose red), and they never commit to a personal button press; they also correctly describe the mechanics (blue majority saves everyone, red majority saves only red-pressers).

gemini.reasoning: The respondent correctly identifies red as the dominant strategy in the game-theoretic sense, acknowledging that it provides a safety guarantee regardless of the majority's choice. While they provide a comprehensive analysis of why one might choose blue (cooperation, long-term stability, morality), they explicitly conclude that red is the individually rational choice in this one-shot dilemma. They do not commit to a personal action, instead framing the dilemma through various analytical lenses, which constitutes performative hedging.
